protocol_details.vertex_matching: exact visible label identity; explicit code anchor; no spatial matching
protocol_details.glyphs: small orthogonal paths supported by two longer body directions; protected labelled corners
protocol_details.text_anchors: resolve visible label binding; presentation offsets are ignored; no nearest-point snap
protocol_details.unused_coordinates: all unlabelled points excluded, including implicit crossings
protocol_details.scope: drawn straight segments between labelled anchors; all supported labelled pairs, including composite segments
protocol_details.ratios: one ordered ratio per unordered pair of incident segments, sorted by visible label
protocol_details.duplicate_labels: same-anchor repeats deduplicated; conflicting anchors unresolved

geometry_quality_protocol.point_alignment: least squares on common labels; translation, rotation and uniform scale; no reflection
geometry_quality_protocol.point_normalizer: maximum reference distance between labelled points
